# Vendored notation renderer

Melodi uses the static browser build of VexFlow **5.0.0**, loaded locally so the GitHub Pages app does not depend on a runtime CDN.

- Runtime: `vexflow-bravura.js` from `vexflow@5.0.0` (`build/cjs/vexflow-bravura.js`), 728,171 bytes.
- Runtime SHA-256: `2d4451bf31c877cf289cf173452b77a6b08e362e3cdf75a1136e485eed3c0f89`.
- Source package: [vexflow@5.0.0](https://registry.npmjs.org/vexflow/-/vexflow-5.0.0.tgz), MIT; see `LICENSE-VexFlow.txt`.
- This build embeds the Bravura music font and Academico text font; their notices are retained in `LICENSE-Bravura.txt` and `LICENSE-Academico.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
- Embedded font package versions: `@vexflow-fonts/bravura@1.0.2` and `@vexflow-fonts/academico@1.0.1`.

No package runtime dependency, build step, external font request, or source map is required.
